'''Shalla''' was a colony of [[Altiri/Legends|Altiri]], on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Priva]], named after a goddess of peace worshipped early in Altiri history.

==History==
Shalla was founded in [[500 BBY/Legends|500 BBY]] by the Altiri and was the first off-planet colonization of [[Altiria/Anarris]] history. It was originally a research station and eventually became a [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] for receiving offworld visitors. Because of the never-ending conflict of the Altiri against the [[Anarrian]], the colony transformed into a defense station.<ref name="TUR" />
